messages:
alex: Observed a perf regression on nightly after landing the dyn-shape torch.compile patch. Throughput down ~12% on seqlen=384 small-batch workloads. nvprof shows a different kernel picked for matmul, and memory copies spiked.
maria: Ugh. Which kernel id? autotuner should pick the same as before.
alex: Kernel name: matmul_sm86_opt_v2; previous was matmul_sm86_smallbatch. Pick changed because compile capture produced constant shapes leading autotuner to prefer high-throughput variant that assumes no KV cache spills.
devon: Can you paste the profiler lines?
alex: nvprof snippet:
```
GPU activities:
cudaMemcpyAsync HtoD [0x7f] 64MB 2.4ms
matmul_sm86_opt_v2 invocations: 14 total 18.9ms
matmul_sm86_smallbatch invocations: 0
```
Looks like capture collapsed batch dim; cudagraphs capture + torch.compile gave fixed shape 1x384, autotuner picked the high occupancy kernel.
li: Does KV cache get reallocated each decode step? That could trigger extra memcpy.
alex: Yes, kv_cache->realloc path hit because graph capture elided the dynamic buffer resize; fallback does a host roundtrip to rebind. See stack:
```
Runtime::capture() -> KVCache::bind_for_cudagraph() -> realloc_if_needed()
```

maria: Proposed fixes: 1) autotuner metric include KV cache footprint penalty; 2) avoid cudagraph capture when dynamic kv rebind path present; 3) add seqlen bucket hint for compile-time.
kevin: Quick experiment: disable cudagraph for seqlen<=512 and force smallbatch kernel. Can you run nightly with env AUTOTUNE_PREFER_SMALL_BATCH=1 and CAPTURE_THRESHOLD=1024?
devon: I'll try. Also adding a cheap probe in runtime to annotate capture with `capture_dynamic_kv=true` so autotuner doesn't treat it as static.
alex: Test run results: throughput recovered ~9% after forcing smallbatch pick, no KV memcpy spikes.
sre-bot: deploy:nightly succeeded for branch dyn-kv-probe (build 5742) :white_check_mark:
maria: Good. Next steps: 1) add a unit test that simulates capture + kv rebind; 2) update autotuner opt to penalize large host<->device memcpy; 3) add telemetry flag to surface kernel swap events in console.
kevin: I'll file the followups.
kevin: Filed: https://tickets/redwood/INF-1847 - include reproducer and nvprof capture.
alex: thanks, will attach logs.
maria: :thumbsup:
